messages:
Jason Lee: FYI pen-test flagged that audit objects for 2025-11-02 appear missing from S3 - suspicion: log rotation + lifecycle rule mismatch.
Maya Chen: can you paste the finding or a link to the report?
Dmitri R: attached snippet in the report, but short repro here. `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit/2025/11/02/` returned only audit-20251102-01.log; expected 01-03. Also manifest shows 01-03.
Nina Patel: Support saw a customer billing spike on 2025-11-02; they opened a ticket referencing missing invoice lines. forwarding ID: req_0a1b2c3.
Maya Chen: ops-bot, can you create an incident for triage?
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20251103-7 (severity: TBD)
Jason Lee: Pen test labeled as P2 (data-retention). If we confirm customer billing is affected, escalate to P1. Need storage/billing correlation.
Dmitri R: Evidence: CloudTrail shows a `DeleteObject` at 03:14:22Z for prefix `2025/11/02/` from an internal lifecycle job. I can dump the events.
Maya Chen: Storage triage steps for reproducibility:
```
1) aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-audit --key manifest-20251102.json --output json > manifest.json
2) jq '.entries[].key' manifest.json | sort > manifest_keys.txt
3) aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit/2025/11/02/ --recursive | awk '{print $4}' | sort > s3_keys.txt
4) diff manifest_keys.txt s3_keys.txt
5) aws s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-audit
```
Maya Chen: Also check S3 event notifications / replication logs and any ad-hoc lifecycle runs.
Nina Patel: I'll ask support to provide the customer's request ids and invoice timestamps so billing can correlate retries.
Dmitri R: I'll rerun the pen test repro against staging (same lifecycle config) and attach timestamps/screenshots. If staging is clean, might be an out-of-band job on prod.
billing-team: Noted. We'll search for retry/ingest jobs around 03:10-03:30Z and match to invoice generation jobs.
storage-team: We'll confirm if lifecycle transition or explicit delete happened. If lifecycle rule misconfigured, we need to patch and backfill.
Jason Lee: Proposed immediate actions:
- storage-team: confirm delete vs lifecycle (ETA 4h)
- billing-team: correlate customer spikes (ETA 3h)
- dmitri: rerun and deliver evidence (ETA 2h)
- nina: customer comms template ready to go (hold until we know impact)

Jason Lee: Assigning folks: @Dmitri R (evidence), @Nina Patel (customer comms), @storage-team, @billing-team.
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert created: PD-4882
Maya Chen: Until we rule out customer impact, I'm leaning P1. We'll reconvene in 3h in this thread. :thumbsup:
